card.name: The word voice after his or tone of
card.fires_on: The word "voice" as a noun for a person's spoken sound, usually right after a possessive like his, my, your or after "tone of". It appears in general web prose, not drug labels.

modes.label: Possessive plus voice
modes.description: "voice" follows his, my or your when describing someone's speaking or singing sound.
modes.example: To judge by the timbre of his<< voice>> I’d say he’s relatively young

modes.label: Voice in set phrases
modes.description: "voice" ends phrases like "tone of voice", "synthetic voice" or "gives voice to".
modes.example: in a "bad guy" tone of<< voice>>. Be sure that you're not teaching

card.plain: It lights up on the word "voice" when it means someone's speaking or singing sound, especially after "his" or "your".
